ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, eye; diagnostic code 6000 covers choroidopathy including uveitis, iritis, cyclitis, or choroiditis under the General Rating Formula for Diseases of the Eye.

conditions.name: Keratitis

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, eye; current diagnostic code 6001 is titled keratopathy and provides the applicable corneal-disease framework for this catalog identity.

reviewNotes: The current schedule uses the broader term 'keratopathy' at DC 6001; this catalog identity does not imply that every keratopathy is keratitis.

conditions.name: Dry Eye Syndrome

ratingSchedule.note: No single diagnosis-specific dry-eye diagnostic code is assigned here. Depending on documented pathology and residuals, evaluation may use the lacrimal-apparatus framework at diagnostic code 6025 or other applicable eye criteria.

reviewNotes: No single condition-specific diagnostic code is assigned in the current schedule; code selection depends on the documented lacrimal, corneal, visual, and treatment findings.

conditions.name: Retinal Dystrophy

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, eye; diagnostic code 6042 covers retinal dystrophy, including retinitis pigmentosa, wet or dry macular degeneration, early-onset macular degeneration, and rod and/or cone dystrophy.

reviewNotes: The existing macular-degeneration catalog entry remains a narrower user-facing identity under the same DC 6042 framework. Macular-degeneration names and aliases are intentionally not duplicated here.

conditions.name: Nystagmus

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, eye; diagnostic code 6016 expressly covers central nystagmus.

reviewNotes: DC 6016 expressly names central nystagmus; other nystagmus types may require a different rating framework and should not be assumed to use DC 6016 without human review.

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, eye; diagnostic code 6019 covers unilateral or bilateral ptosis and directs evaluation based on visual impairment or, when absent, disfigurement.
